review.rationale: Re-reviewed the original 2026-09-04 v4.2 chart after an independent reviewer flagged a label-reading error. The chart shows GPT-6 Astra (max) at 56% and GLM-5.3 (max) at 59%; the prior 56% GLM value was incorrect. The methodology supports the percent pass@1/subproblem metric, dataset v1.0.1, 288 test subproblems, three repeats, and 300-second isolated executor timeout.
